ratio_selection: Maximum mean over seeds 42,43,44 of common full-24s validation 19-class argmax macro-F1; round to 8 decimals for ties, then smaller ratio. ROS and GAN selected separately per prefix; also retain same-count ROS at selected GAN ratio.
duration_selection: Among raw 12D prefixes 6,12,24, maximum three-seed mean full-24s validation argmax macro-F1; round to 8 decimals for ties, then shorter prefix. Recommendation fixed before new test.
main_metric: 19-class logits.argmax; no detection threshold in main window classification

stages.late_fault_12_24: fault records, start index >=1200 and end index <2400
stages.transition: retained fault windows with start index <400

alarm_selection: Existing select_alarm_policy objective and tie rule; full-24s validation only, separately per model and seed. Never reset inference at fault time.
test_policy: New three-group test features and cached arrays require matching immutable freeze and all trained checkpoint/scaler hashes; all development and selections complete before a single unified test evaluation.
